standard-dialogue.npc: Oh, I do declare! Another perambulating soul traipses through this verdant forest!
Salutations, my good compatriot! Pray, what curious happenstance is it that brings yourself out to my sylvan domicile?
The rainforest! A most resplendent deviation from the cacophonous tyranny of urban existence.

standard-dialogue.player: It's certainly more colourful, that's for sure.

standard-dialogue.npc: Indeed! Out here, one may emancipate themselves amidst blissful tranquility.

standard-dialogue.player: I see... So how does such a... magniloquent individual... come to be out here?

standard-dialogue.npc: Well, it commenced when I was merely a youth, and has proceeded uninterrupted ever since.

standard-dialogue.player: You came out here as a child?

standard-dialogue.npc: I was most fortuitously deposited within this locale by my progenitors, along with this extravagant bundle of novels. Behold this one!

standard-dialogue.text: The odd individual shows you a book.

standard-dialogue.npc: What an exquisitely scandalous read it was. Now, you seem like someone who appreciates linguistic variety! Would you care to partake in a spot of intellectual cultivation with me?

standard-dialogue.player: I'm not sure if that's quite...

standard-dialogue.npc: I possess a cornucopia of literary marvels. This one by Di. C. Tionary is captivating.

standard-dialogue.text: The odd individual shows you another book.

standard-dialogue.npc: No! Di. C. Tionary. She's one of the foremost novelists of our time. Such an unparalleled way with words. I'd love to have an audience with her some day.
Tell me, have you met any of the literary greats?

standard-dialogue.player: I've not had an opportunity to.

standard-dialogue.npc: A tragedy, to be unequivocally certain.

standard-dialogue.player: Yes... Anyway, I think I need to get going now...

standard-dialogue.npc: Very well! I shan't exasperate you with excessive and superfluous conversation. Besides, my tomes beckon. Farewell.

standard-dialogue-using-an-item-on-him.npc: I have little to say on this object. Congratulations on your ownership of it.
